fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: Pick a field. The list is filtered by 'Applies To' (parent vs. the chosen child table).

fields.label: Applies To
fields.options:
Parent
Position Details
Position Summary
Qualifications
Skills
Pre-screened Candidates
fields.description: Which part of the requisition this field belongs to. 'Parent' = a Job Requisition field; the others target a child-table column.

fields.label: Label Override
fields.description: Optional. Replaces the meta label for the external form only.

fields.label: Expose
fields.description: Default = follow the DocType meta. Show = force-include. Hide = exclude from the external form (and from the write allowlist).

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: Default = follow meta 'reqd'. Required/Optional force the external form + server validation.

fields.label: Read Only
fields.description: Default = follow meta. Read Only shows the field but drops it from the write allowlist.

fields.label: Hiring Type
fields.description: Only used when 'Configure Basis Hiring Type' is ticked on the parent. Both = render for every requisition. Fresher / Lateral = render only for that hiring type.

fields.label: Tab Override
fields.description: Optional. Regroup this field under a different tab than the DocType layout.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Optional sort hint within a section (lower first). 0 = keep meta order.

fields.label: Options Override
fields.description: Optional. Overrides Select options (newline separated) for the external form.

fields.label: Child Table Columns (only when this field is a Table)
Selected Child Fields (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of child column fieldnames to expose. Empty = all columns.

fields.label: Mandatory Child Fields (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of child column fieldnames to force mandatory. Empty = follow child meta.
